title: Picks of the week social carousel
slide_intent: Preview adjacent items so a viewer understands that a recommendation card is the start of a sequence.
strategic_value: A green opening card and repeated colored captions can connect Channel 4 recommendations while supporting browsing.
demonstration: A phone carousel starts with Picks of the week and a popcorn icon, nudges sideways to programme recommendations and returns to the opening card.
practical_value: Compare the visible sliver of the next card with a completely closed composition.

content_islands.name: Opening recommendation
content_islands.spec: Use green behind the weekly heading, icon and streaming instruction.

content_islands.name: Programme cards
content_islands.spec: Slide to images with colored title-and-time bands while keeping the social interface visible.

reference_purposes.Application: A mobile social carousel applies the nudge mechanic to weekly programme recommendations.
reference_purposes.Intent: Pentagram explains that partial views of adjoining worlds hint at more content to explore.
